lineage.outcome: The first-class incident-repair lifecycle can reach its own evidence-bound terminal closure without resolving the still-open parent incident or weakening its unrelated-merge block.

implementation_contract.exclusive_mode: This is continuation work on the exact existing ACTIVE repair identity; it does not select a new incident repair or product increment.
implementation_contract.closure_authority: The general blocking-incident gate may recognize closed_incident_repair_ids only when repair_kind is exactly INCIDENT_REPAIR_CLOSURE. It must not treat inert historical closed IDs under any other receipt kind as authority.
implementation_contract.specialized_validation: Recognition by the general gate is not sufficient to authorize closure. The trusted workflow must still run check_incident_repair_authority.py, which requires terminal lifecycle, exact prior ACTIVE receipt binding, exact three-path closure manifest, evidence-bound incident completion, and no active incident_repair_ids.
implementation_contract.parent_incident: Parent incident #206 remains OPEN with blocking_scope BLOCKING_EXCEPT_EXPLICIT_INCIDENT_REPAIR and unrelated_merges_blocked=true. This repair must not reclassify it as non-blocking or resolved.
implementation_contract.noninterference: Normal ACTIVE incident repair authority remains unchanged; unrelated closure IDs and closed IDs outside INCIDENT_REPAIR_CLOSURE grant no authority.
